fact: On 3 November 2026 the Supreme Court rejected the State's request and kept suspended the arrêté n° 038974 of 6 November 2025 authorising Starlink Sénégal SUARL to provide fixed satellite internet for five years, blocking commercial operation.
title: Starlink au Sénégal : la Cour suprême maintient la suspension de l'autorisation d'exploitation
